content.comment_body: Hello Experts, In previous [product_name] version [article_no], the I/O count is 24 digital inputs and 16 digital outputs. For my project, I require 24 digital inputs, 16 digital outputs, 4 analog inputs, 2 RTD analog inputs, and 6 analog outputs. Can the newer [product_name] version [article_no] handle these requirements? Thanks.

Hi, One [product_name] base module handles 24 digital inputs, 16 digital outputs, 8 analog inputs, and 2 analog outputs, but you need 6 analog outputs. To achieve this with [product_name], you would require two extra base units operating in slave mode with expansion modules for analog outputs.
